rule: A test is flagged when it has 4+ weeks of evidence (2+ live), wins 0.5+ more categories a week than the current plan, and is 90% likely to be better, not lucky.

strategies.name: Current: one streaming spot
strategies.summary: Week planner streams one spot almost daily (what the brief recommends)
today: Drop Damian Lillard, then move Josh Hart off IR
Add Ausar Thompson for Daniel Gafford

strategies.name: Fill every slot
strategies.summary: Fill every open lineup slot daily with the best free agent who plays

Add Ausar Thompson for Damian Lillard

Add Santi Aldama for Josh Hart

strategies.name: Smart fill
strategies.summary: Fill open slots only when an add gains 0.02+ expected categories; protect close percentages late in the week

Add Santi Aldama for Tari Eason
Add Walter Clayton Jr. for Kel'el Ware

strategies.name: Two streaming spots
strategies.summary: Current plan plus a second streaming spot planned the same way
today: Drop Damian Lillard, then move Josh Hart off IR
Add Ausar Thompson for Daniel Gafford
Spot B: add Jamal Shead for Kel'el Ware

strategies.name: Monday schedule stack
strategies.summary: Monday: swap holds for free agents with the most games, then hold

strategies.name: Hold (reference)
strategies.summary: IR moves and open-spot fills only, no swaps

notes: Weeks 1, 2, 3 were replayed from saved data (backtest). At most 2 backtest weeks count as evidence.

Limits: other managers do not react to paper moves, paper teams cannot react to late news the way the 5:03 PM check can, and paper totals will differ from your real results. These apply to every paper team equally, so the comparison stays fair.
